statement:
The record shows a refund amount of **USD 23,000.00** for a purchase that was originally **USD 230.00**.

This is clearly an error—I will **hold** the refund and not take any action.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the refund amount of $23,000 against a $230 purchase is "clearly an error" and holds the refund.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
